searchText: Yes def multitoken, in my mind the 80/20 play here is to support private transfers of ETH + ERC20 with subcent cost and other harder-to-measure but desired properties Lets say Plasma Fold (will be renamed to Plasma Blind) is just one bet into the expanding design space on here. From my POV Kohaku helps two parts: i) showcase how to integrate all these protocols with (hopefully) great UX (ala Zashi) and ii) lowering the cost of integration for devs (devex) For I've seen: mixers, shielded pools, encrypted tokens, tee-based, folding-based, mpc-based, full zk-based... so many exploding design space
